title: Emma's Health Update
content: Emma has been diagnosed with an early stage of cancer. She is currently considering treatment options and has only shared this information with close family members. She may discuss her health further at the upcoming Thompson Family Reunion.

title: Thompson Family Reunion Planning
content: The Thompson Family Reunion is scheduled for March 25th. We need to finalize the guest list and send out the invitations by next week. Mary is bringing the casserole, and John is in charge of the event photography.
